lesson.title: Answer the Drop
lesson.hook: They drop-shot you. You get there. Now where they go decides your answer, and the counter-drop is usually the trap.
lesson.memHTML: Get there, look up, then go deep.
lesson.tomorrow: Next time you're drop-shotted, look up as you reach it: are they coming in, holding, or backing off?

drill.name: Drop and read
drill.how: Your partner feeds a drop, then either holds mid-court, follows it in or backs off. Sprint in, look up, and answer: deep behind them if they stay or come in, deep through the middle if they back off.

lesson.cue: Get there, look up, go deep.

steps.name: They stay mid-court
steps.sit: They drop-shot you and stay mid-court, where they hit it. You get there in time.
steps.payoff: From mid-court they can't get back to the deep corner.
steps.principle: If they stay, go deep behind them.
steps.why: They're stuck mid-court, so the deep corner is behind them and out of reach. The counter-drop from behind your service line sits up for them; the short angle is right where they are.
steps.take: They stay mid-court? Deep behind them.

lines.A: From back here it sits up for them. At your feet.
lines.B: Deep middle comes straight back. You volley it back.
lines.C: Right: deep behind them. They can't get back to it.
lines.D: Short angle is right where they are. Passed.

steps.name: They retreat
steps.sit: Same drop. This time they back off to the baseline as you run in.
steps.payoff: They're back and balanced: no winner here. Reset deep through the middle.
steps.principle: If they back off, there's no winner. Keep it deep and central.
steps.why: From the baseline they have time to run down the corner and pass you. The counter-drop catches them coming in. Deep through the middle gives them no angle, and you volley again.
steps.take: They back off? Deep through the middle.

lines.A: From the baseline they run it down and pass you.
lines.B: They're on it in time: it's at your feet.
lines.C: They get there and pass you.
lines.D: Right: no angle for them. You're still in the point.

steps.name: They follow it in
steps.sit: This time they follow their drop in toward the net.
steps.payoff: Coming forward, they can't turn and chase a deep ball.
steps.principle: If they come in, go deep behind them. Not the counter-drop.
steps.why: Moving forward, they can't get back for anything deep. The counter-drop is the trap: from behind your service line it doesn't stay low enough, and they're already there.
steps.take: They follow it in? Go deep.

lines.A: Right: deep, and they can't get back. Winner.
lines.C: The trap: they're already there. At your feet.
lines.D: Deep into the corner works too. Winner.
